completion_notes: Added __experimental__: bool = True flag to mfem_printer.py and moose_printer.py. Created _experimental.py defining ExperimentalBackendWarning(UserWarning). Both printers warn on first emit() call (one-shot via _emit_warned flag, stacklevel=2). codegen/__init__.py module docstring extended with Backend support tiers + __experimental__ convention sections; P5-1 compile() docstring preserved verbatim. Gate B noted three minor (no blocking): test gap on second-call no-warn, direct flag mutation vs MonkeyPatch, duplicated warning block across printers — all acceptable for current scope.
